The '''Yir Tangee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yir Tangee/Legends|Yir Tangee]].<ref name="Heroes" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Havriso Looruya]] was appointed as a representative of Yir Tangee to the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]&mdash;a committee formed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="HNN49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="HNNDate1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> to assist in negotiations for the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|crisis]]<ref name="HNN49" /> spurred by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] attempts to secede from the Republic.<ref name="Crisis">{{CSWECite|I|137|Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS)}}</ref> Later in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="HNNDate2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_2.html|Rodian Senator Uncovers Loyalist-Separatist Ties}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:5:2," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Looruya stepped down from the committee<ref name="Rodia">{{CSWECite|III|105|Rodia}}</ref> amid accusations of funding Separatists<ref name="HNN 54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_2.html|Rodian Senator Uncovers Loyalist-Separatist Ties}}</ref> and was replaced by Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]],<ref name="HNN 55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_4.html|Senator Farr Named to Loyalist Committee}}</ref> a representative of the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Rodia" />

A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="Heroes" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] created by members of the medically advanced [[Carosite]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Alien">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> the ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'', was preparing medical supplies for the ravaged planet of Yir Tangee. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Keoulkeech]] joined the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] journey to bring medical aid to worlds suffering from the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yir Tangee system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] that placed it in grid square L-8.<ref name="Atlas" />
